name: Z-Cube Dollar 3x3 (UV Printed)
description: The Z-Cube Dollar 3x3 (UV Printed) wraps a standard-size 3x3 in a full one-dollar bill design — Washington portrait, Federal Reserve seals, serial numbers, and "One Dollar" wordmarks running across every face. It's a non-magnetic 3x3 built around a frosted matte finish, made for collectors, gift-givers, and casual cubers who want a puzzle that looks as good on a shelf as it does in the hand.
features: Standout design: A full dollar-bill graphic printed across all six sides — easily one of the most recognizable novelty prints in the hobby.
Conversation piece: Sits well on a desk or shelf as a display cube, and pulls double duty as a fun gift for cubers and non-cubers alike.
Standard 56mm size: Familiar form factor that fits most hands and most cube stands.
UV-printed graphics: The dollar bill artwork is UV printed directly onto the plastic, so the design is part of the cube rather than a sticker that can peel.
Frosted matte finish: A soft, low-glare surface that resists fingerprints and gives the cube a clean, paper-like look in line with the bill graphic.
Standard 3x3 mechanism: Familiar turning behavior with no learning curve coming from a traditional speed cube.
